Government of India
Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
Department of Personnel & Training
****

North Block, New Delhi
Dated the 24th February, 2025
Subject: Extension of tenure of Shri Jagdish Khima Rathod, CPES(2002), CVO, DPA, Kandla.
Reference: Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways' O.M. No. C-31015/1/2021-Vigilance (C.No. 346823) dated 14.02.2025 on the subject mentioned above.

2. The Competent Authority has approved the proposal for extension of deputation tenure of Shri Jagdish Khima Rathod, CPES (2002), CVO, Deendayal Port Authority (DPA), Kandla for a period of 2 years beyond 02.06.2025 i.e. upto 02.06.2027 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

Under Secretary to the Government of India
Tel. No. 2309 2589

Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways
[Shri Dhrub Kumar, Under Secretary(Vig.)]
Transport Bhawan, 1, Parliament Street,
New Delhi.

1. The Secretary, M/o Power, Shram Shakti Bhavan, New Delhi.
2. The Secretary, Central Vigilance Commission, Satarkta Bhawan, GPO Complex, Block-A, INA, New Delhi-110 023.
3. Shri Jagdish Khima Rathod, CPES (2002), CVO, Deendayal Port Authority (DPA), Kandla through M/o Ports, Shipping & Waterways.
4. PS to MoS(PP)/ PSO to Secretary(P)/PPS to EO/ DIR(SM)/DS(MM)
